neighbours.label: a span of time measured in hours or minutes spent on something (eight hours of play, ten minutes of homework, divmod of a duration), as against the same quantity frames with non-time units
fire: The campaign took roughly twelve hours of gameplay to complete.
Experts recommend thirty minutes of exercise for adults every day.
The pilots logged nearly 300 hours of flight time last year.
After six hours of waiting, the passengers finally boarded.
The course includes forty hours of video lectures.
He practised the piano for two hours a day all summer.
Children should get at least an hour of reading each evening.
quiet: The campaign took roughly twelve boxes of leaflets to complete.
Experts recommend thirty grams of fibre for adults every day.
The pilots carried nearly 300 kilograms of cargo last year.
After six rounds of voting, the delegates finally agreed.
The course includes forty pages of printed notes.
He bought the piano for two thousand dollars last summer.
Children should get at least a cup of milk each evening.
